summary: Verified GRN retry+diagnostics refresh behavior on /admin/grn-approval end-to-end with mocked retry POST + polling GET (no real SAP call). BOTH retry code paths (top-level pending-lookup retryGoodsReceipt and confirmed-detail retryConfirmedGoodsReceipt) correctly poll the job to completion, then replace the shipment state with the LATEST attempt's result. Diagnostics dialog shows only NEW error/events after retry, OLD stale diagnostics are fully removed from the DOM. The Sep 12 2026 fix (open confirmed-detail dialog refreshes in-place, not just the closed list) is confirmed working.

seed_fixture_issue.issue: Seeded shipment TSTRTY had sap_sync_status='failed' with sap_gr_retry_count=1, but per frontend logic (GrnApprovalPage.jsx lines 783-786) the top-level shipment detail renders 'Reset Retry' (grn-reset-retry-button) instead of 'Retry' (grn-retry-goods-receipt-button) whenever sap_sync_status==='failed', regardless of retry_count. This is intentional escalation UX (per Sep 10 2026 comment: after MAX_GR_RETRIES_BEFORE_FAILED, force manual SAP intervention), but it made the requested TEST 1 selector unreachable with the exact seed described. On backend, finalize_goods_receipt only flips to 'failed' when retry_count >= MAX_GR_RETRIES_BEFORE_FAILED, so 'failed + retry_count=1' is not a naturally producible state - the seed is internally inconsistent with the state machine.
seed_fixture_issue.workaround_used: Temporarily set sap_sync_status='pending' on TSTRTY, ran TEST 1, reverted seed back to the exact original shape (sap_sync_status='failed', retry_count=1, per_po OLD diagnostics preserved).
seed_fixture_issue.recommendation: For any future reruns of this specific pending-lookup retry test, seed with sap_sync_status='pending' (or 'skipped') + retry_count < MAX to make the top-level Retry button reachable. The confirmed-detail Retry path does NOT have this restriction - its Retry button shows for any non-posted status once cooldown has passed.

code_review_findings: retryGoodsReceipt (line 418) and retryConfirmedGoodsReceipt (line 165) both correctly: (1) call POST retry, (2) await pollGrnJob to final result, (3) setShipment/setConfirmedDetail with the fresh result, (4) call openDiagnosticsIfFailed on non-posted outcomes. Contract with backend GET /admin/grn/receipt-status/{job_id} response ({status, phase, progress_current, progress_total, result, error}) is correct.
pollGrnJob (line 369) has a 6-minute deadline and 2.5s poll interval - reasonable for the described 1-2 minute real SAP scenarios.
Diagnostics dialog (line 1180) correctly rebuilds from the fresh per_po entry passed in - no memoized/stale state.

Minor UX inconsistency (not a bug): the top-level detail hides Retry once sap_sync_status='failed' and forces 'Reset Retry', while the confirmed-detail dialog still shows Retry in that same state. The two UIs disagree on whether user should be allowed to retry a fully-failed shipment. Confirm with product whether this intentional divergence is desired, or the top-level should also show 'Retry' as long as retry_count < MAX.
